items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I used to love to hear him play bass.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, he, I think... Bill Johnson. Bill Johnson. I'm trying to find him again. I haven't seen him in years. I don't know what become of Bill.
Mm-hmm. Bill was... But he said he went to Mexico, maybe. Yeah.
That's what I heard of, that he was down to Mexico or something. I haven't seen him for over ten years.
